The photon energy is related to its wavelength by  

\[
E=\frac{hc}{\lambda}\;\;\Longrightarrow\;\;\lambda=\frac{1240\ \text{eV·nm}}{E}
\]

\[
\lambda=\frac{1240\ \text{eV·nm}}{2.3393\ \text{eV}}\approx 5.30\times10^{2}\ \text{nm}=530\ \text{nm}
\]

A wavelength of about 530 nm lies in the green‑yellow region of the visible spectrum. The closest listed colour is **yellow**.

**Answer: A**
